sentences.display: Four centuries later, in Damascus, the scholar Ibn Kathīr agreed.
sentences.tts: Four centuries later, in Damascus, the scholar Ibn Katheer agreed.

sentences.display: Whether the ʿimād were buildings, or tent poles, or weapons, or the height of the people, he wrote, ʿĀd were a tribe: "a nation among the nations".
sentences.tts: Whether the ee-maad were buildings, or tent poles, or weapons, or the height of the people, he wrote, Aa-d were a tribe: a nation among the nations.
